experiment_data.hypothesis: K=2 L2 divergence-based adaptive K allocation (P50 threshold τ=0.074855) transfers from Object to Spatial benchmark, achieving comparable SR to fixed K=10 with ~62% compute savings. Cross-benchmark validation of adaptive K as core method.

spec.command: bash -c "source /root/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh && conda activate base && cd /root/acr-vla-conformal-refinement && HF_HOME=/root/autodl-tmp/.hf_cache HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1 TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE=1 MUJOCO_GL=egl python -u src/evaluate.py --mode adaptive_k --adaptive_threshold 0.074855 --k_full 10 --benchmark spatial --seed 44 --n_rollouts 10 --crm_checkpoint /root/autodl-tmp/checkpoints/crm_v3_norm/obs_only/crm_best.pt --max_correction_norm 0.2 --output_file logs/eval_adaptive_k_spatial_p50_seed44.json"
